name: Boundary TCP – 3 minutes at KITAL
description: Two aircraft at the same level reach the Muscat/Mumbai boundary point KITAL 3 minutes apart (India–Oman LoA requires 10 min). Modelled on the 2025 Arabian Sea near-miss, where the conflict was missed because strips were not scanned and updated.
